newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks recoup, end above 1,500 points.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks recoup, end above 1,500 points.

text.p: Pakistani stocks recouped and ended above the 1,500-point psychological barrier on Wednesday's new accounts day on buying of blue chips by investors, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.

The KSE 100-share index, which fell to 1,489.04 in early trade on selling pressure intensified by tension over a reported Indian missile deployment, rebounded and closed 2.03 points, or 0.14 percent, up at 1,501.76 amid 206 losers and 89 gainers.
Heavy buying in blue chips pulled the index up, dealer Azhar Batla of Taurus Securities said.
